name: desktop-mascot-ui
description: A transparent desktop mascot with never-lost screen recovery, verified live apply, effect preview, and no-code image editing
author: onoayami

scripts.build:mac: npm run check:build-lock && npm run check && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run check:build-lock && npm run check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run check:build-lock && npm run check && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run check:build-lock && npm run check && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.test:phase0: npm run test:phase0:harness && npm run test:phase0:known-defects
scripts.test:automated: npm run check && npm run test:phase0:harness && npm run test:phase0:known-defects && npm run test:release-a1 && npm run test:release-a2 && npm run test:release-a3 && npm run test:release-b && npm run test:release-c && npm run test:release-d
